collector.name: yt-dlp
collector.method: yt-dlp --skip-download --dump-single-json (public webpage metadata, no media downloaded)

notes: Snapshot grounded in the raw yt-dlp payload stored at the referenced path (immutable audit artifact). views/likes/comments/saves map directly from view_count/like_count/comment_count/save_count in that payload. shares is null because the payload exposes repost_count=1465 and the repost->shares mapping is unverified; it is deliberately not asserted as shares. follower_count_at_observation is null because the payload does not include creator follower count.
